part.text:
Fixed. The bug: in `GroupByQueryQueryToolChest.pullFromCache` (processing/src/main/java/org/apache/druid/query/groupby/GroupByQueryQueryToolChest.java:780), when reading result-level-cache rows, the post-aggregator loop never incremented `postPos`, so every cached post-aggregator value was written into the first post-agg slot (last value wins) and the remaining slots stayed null. This is invisible with 0 or 1 post-aggregator but corrupts results with 2+ — exactly matching the reported symptoms (a2 got a3's value, a3 was null). The one-line fix increments `postPos` each iteration.

Validation: `mvn -pl processing test -Dtest=GroupByQueryQueryToolChestTest` → 20 tests, 0 failures, including `doTestCacheStrategy` which round-trips a cache row with two post-aggregators (`post`=10, `post2`=20) through `prepareForCache(true)`/`pullFromCache(true)`.
